chunks: And by this chain, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) regarding the saying:
of Allāh, the Exalted: “Indeed, those who turned back on their heels after the guidance had become clear to them”
“So-and-so, and so-and-so, and so-and-so turned back from īmān in abandoning the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام).”
“That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down: We shall obey you in part of the matter.”

He said: “By Allāh, it was revealed about those two and about their followers, and it is the saying of Allāh, Mighty and Majestic, which Jibrāʾīl (عليه السلام) brought down upon Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله).”
“That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down concerning ʿAlī (عليه السلام): We shall obey you in part of the matter.”

He said: “They called Banū Umayyah to their pact that the authority should not be placed among us after the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), and that they should not give us anything from the khums. And they said: If we give it to them, they will not be in need of anything, and they will not care whether the authority is among them. So they said: We shall obey you in part of the matter to which you have called us, and it is the khums: that we should not give them anything from it.”

And his saying, ‘they disliked what Allāh sent down’ means: what Allāh sent down, namely what He made obligatory upon His creation from the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام). And Abū ʿUbaydah was with them, and he was their scribe.
So Allāh revealed: “Or have they resolved upon a matter? Then indeed We are resolute. Or do they think that We do not hear their secret and their private counsel?” — the verse.

key_terms.ارْتَدُّوا: turned back or reneged after guidance had become clear
key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith, specifically in relation to accepting the divinely mandated truth
key_terms.الْخُمُسِ: the one-fifth due allocated by divine law
key_terms.سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُمْ: their secret and private confidential discourse
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: the divinely appointed authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret Qur'an 47:25-26 regarding the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This narration presents a tafsīr of verses from Sūrat Muḥammad as referring to those who turned away from the wilayah of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī (عليه السلام) after guidance had become clear. It further links the verse to an agreement concerning political authority and the withholding of khums, framing these actions as opposition to what Allāh had revealed regarding ʿAlī (عليه السلام).
